question.prompt: Should I treat transferring from an account to the same account as allowed or blocked?

options.label: Proceed with gap
options.detail: Do not assume a same-account rule; I will record it as an open gap instead of minting a concrete scenario outcome.

options.label: Provide source
options.detail: Give a file path or URL that states whether same-account transfers are allowed or rejected.

options.label: Specify rule
options.detail: Type whether same-account transfers should be allowed or blocked.

content.risk_rationale: Eligibility rules for source and destination accounts affect whether same-account transfer coverage belongs in a negative path or is out of scope for this use case.
